answer_1.quote: Document summarization -producing the shorter version of a document while preserving salient information -is challenging even for humans.

answer_2.quote: Lexical Overlap We report ROUGE F1 scores against reference summaries; in particular, we report on ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2 for informativeness and ROUGE-L for fluency. Semantic Similarity We report BERTScore which computes the contextual similarity between a candidate and its reference summary. Faithfulness ... we report the probability of a summary entailing (ent.) its input document and QA-based Feqa scores ... we train a scorer ... and call this metric BERTFaithful.
